info.title: SYMBIO API
info.description: SYMBIO — turning industrial by-products into industrial resources. Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Send `X-Organization-Id` to act as a specific organization when a user belongs to several. All errors use the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}}`.

text.title: Text
examples: Granulated slag from our blast furnace, 2k t/month

note.title: Note
note.default: Suggestions only. Confirm the correct material before publishing.

ConnectionTarget.title: ConnectionTarget
ConnectionTarget.description:
Who the user would connect with, about which listing, through the existing connection flow.

Only an opportunity for the *same* resource ↔ requirement pair qualifies; a pathway never borrows
an opportunity about a different listing.

CounterpartContact.title: CounterpartContact
CounterpartContact.description: Revealed only after a connection is accepted.

CurrentDisposition.title: CurrentDisposition
CurrentDisposition.description: What happens to the resource today (the environmental baseline).

overall_score.title: Overall Score
overall_score.description: Route score on the same basis as the processed pathway

DirectComparison.title: DirectComparison
DirectComparison.description: The raw material sold straight to the same buyer, for side-by-side comparison.

route_score.title: Route Score
route_score.description: Route score on the same basis as processed pathways

delivered_quantity.title: Delivered Quantity
delivered_quantity.description: Actual total quantity delivered; recorded as a user-reported outcome for impact tracking

next_step.title: Next Step
next_step.default: Review each suggested value on the resource and confirm or reject it before it is used.

ListingView.title: ListingView
ListingView.description: Listing details as visible to the viewer (own side: full; counterpart: limited until connected).

LocationPublic.title: LocationPublic
LocationPublic.description: Approximate location shown before a connection exists.

OperatingMode.title: OperatingMode
OperatingMode.description:
Which workspace(s) the organization uses. Controls UI/workflow only —
it never restricts what data an organization may own (locked principle 2).

first_facility.description: Defaults to a facility at the headquarters location

OrganizationPublic.title: OrganizationPublic
OrganizationPublic.description: What any signed-in organization may see: no contacts, no exact address.

pathways_active.title: Pathways Active
pathways_active.description: False when the resource is not active; no pathways are generated

buyer_match_id.title: Buyer Match Id
buyer_match_id.description: Existing opportunity for this same resource ↔ requirement pair, if any (see connection_target)

PropertyValueIn.title: PropertyValueIn
PropertyValueIn.description: A measured/declared value on a Resource, e.g. ``{"property_key": "sio2_pct", "value_numeric": 52}``.

intended_application_id.title: Intended Application Id
intended_application_id.description: What the material is for (enables hidden matches across material names)

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Publish immediately (ACTIVE) instead of saving a DRAFT

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Replaces all user-entered property values when provided

ValueSource.title: ValueSource
ValueSource.description: Provenance of a technical value. Only confirmed values feed matching.
